notes.title: Changes for the better!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
- Matching doors to wall frames
- Candles have the color of wax
- Lighting repair
- Increased appearance time of some texts
- Repair of bugged books
- Better lighting of important places

Cosmetic aspects:
- Added fog
- Increased the gamma of the game world
- Added glittering light effect
- Beautification of some model textures
